constraints_applied: GPU treated as optional unless explicitly required by contract files

dependencies.name: Windows host + PowerShell launch path
dependencies.rationale: Canonical runtime model and launch scripts are Windows-centric.

dependencies.name: Python >= 3.10
dependencies.rationale: Package contract declares minimum interpreter version.

dependencies.name: Conda environment manager (`conda run` workflow)
dependencies.rationale: Environment isolation and interpreter binding are explicit protocol standards.

dependencies.name: YAML config parsing (`PyYAML`)
dependencies.rationale: Canonical config loader reads YAML into runtime config.

dependencies.name: SQLite (memory DB + knowledge graph DB)
dependencies.rationale: Persistence contract marks SQLite-backed stores as authoritative.

dependencies.name: Qdrant service on port 6333
dependencies.rationale: Canonical vector store is configured and launch-scripted.

dependencies.name: Local storage topology rooted at L:/_DATA
dependencies.rationale: Runtime paths are pre-bound to local Windows data roots.

dependencies.name: NVIDIA GPU + CUDA 12.1 profile
dependencies.rationale: Required only when GPU_ENHANCED profile is active; CPU-safe fallbacks exist for all referenced steps.

dependencies.name: PyTorch baseline in active multimodal environments
dependencies.rationale: Technical standards and dependency manifests include torch as primary execution library.

dependencies.name: WSL2 Ubuntu compute extension for audio
dependencies.rationale: Audio path uses WSL2, while protocol allows optional enrichments to fail without halting ingestion.

dependencies.name: WSL audio virtualenv and CUDA library path bootstrap
dependencies.rationale: Only required for the WSL audio execution path.

dependencies.name: FFmpeg executable
dependencies.rationale: Media extraction checks/path resolution are present and runtime marks missing tool as unavailable.

dependencies.name: Tesseract OCR stack (`pytesseract`, Pillow, binary)
dependencies.rationale: OCR path is a best-effort feature with graceful degradation.

dependencies.name: Poppler `pdftotext`
dependencies.rationale: PDF extraction shell-outs to pdftotext and returns null on failure.

dependencies.name: FastAPI + Uvicorn server
dependencies.rationale: API server is available/scaffolded and separately configurable.

dependencies.name: FAISS local indices
dependencies.rationale: Marked as fallback/when-enabled store behind canonical Qdrant.

dependencies.name: ChromaDB + LangChain packages
dependencies.rationale: Present in API requirements and checked as non-primary vector backend.

dependencies.name: Local LLM backends (LM Studio, vLLM, Ollama)
dependencies.rationale: Multiple local backend endpoints are configured for selection/fallback.

dependencies.name: Home Assistant integration
dependencies.rationale: Separate integration section with env-token reference and dedicated env dependency.

dependencies.name: Face recognition (`facenet-pytorch`)
dependencies.rationale: Feature marked disabled when package is absent.

dependencies.name: Audio diarization/transcription model stack (`pyannote`, `whisperx`, `faster-whisper`)
dependencies.rationale: Feature-specific audio packages in dedicated environments.

dependencies.name: Scene detection stack (`scenedetect`, OpenCV)
dependencies.rationale: Loaded conditionally as an engine capability.

dependencies.name: GPU execution path in diarization (with CPU fallback)
dependencies.rationale: Code dynamically selects CUDA when present and handles fallback conditions.

dependencies.name: NAS / secondary external pathing
dependencies.rationale: Config includes non-core external path targets.

dependencies.name: WSL diarization/transcription services (queue + direct mode)
dependencies.rationale: Audio architecture defines dedicated WSL service/direct invocation components.

dependencies.name: `pytest`
dependencies.rationale: Test discovery and runner docs are pytest-specific.

dependencies.name: `pytest-cov`
dependencies.rationale: Coverage invocation/install references are test-only.

dependencies.name: `black`
dependencies.rationale: Formatting check command appears in contributor workflow commands.

dependencies.name: `mypy`
dependencies.rationale: Type-check command appears in contributor workflow commands.

forensic_notes: Classification follows explicit contracts first (AGENTS.md), then manifests/config, then runtime entrypoint code.
GPU is marked REQUIRED only where contract language is explicit; feature-level GPU usage remains OPTIONAL where CPU fallback logic exists.
No dependency installation guidance included by design.
